description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeRuntime module, focusing on trigger detection, content trimming, and wake word gating logic.

classes.name: VoiceWakeRuntimeTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests for the VoiceWakeRuntime functionalities.

methods.name: `trims after trigger keeps post speech`
methods.description: Tests that the trimming function correctly removes the trigger words and keeps the post-speech.

methods.name: `trims after trigger returns original when no trigger`
methods.description: Ensures that if no trigger is present, the original text is returned unchanged.

methods.name: `trims after first matching trigger`
methods.description: Checks that the trimming stops at the first detected trigger.

methods.name: `has content after trigger false when only trigger`
methods.description: Verifies that no additional content is detected after the trigger if only the trigger is spoken.

methods.name: `has content after trigger true when speech continues`
methods.description: Verifies that content is detected after the trigger when speech continues.

methods.name: `trims after chinese trigger keeps post speech`
methods.description: Ensures support for Chinese trigger words in trimming logic.

methods.name: `trims after trigger handles width insensitive forms`
methods.description: Checks that full-width character forms in trigger words are handled correctly.

methods.name: `gate requires gap between trigger and command`
methods.description: Tests that the gating logic enforces a minimum gap between wake word and command.

methods.name: `gate accepts gap and extracts command`
methods.description: Verifies that the gating logic correctly extracts commands when the gap condition is met.

methods.name: `gate command text handles foreign string ranges`
methods.description: Tests handling of foreign language string ranges within the transcript for command extraction.
